use: The first upload is the photographer’s own CC0 view squarely facing the basilica. It shows the two spires, nested arch and rose, portal canopy, terrace and steps, louvred belfry pairs and corner pinnacles.

Used Share Bear’s exact February 2007 original from Commons file history. The photographer originally dedicated it to the public domain. It shows the green standing-seam nave roof, side aisle windows, transept and rounded chapel projections.
Shrine’s descriptions and approximate main dimensions, three copper double doors, and rose and figure placement.
Official record of the silver granite walls, standing-seam copper roofs, twin octagonal spires, Latin cross, ambulatory and ten chapels.
